fields.name: beginFavorites
fields.description: Favorite count (start), combined with end value to form the upstream favorites range

fields.name: beginFavoritesWeekly
fields.description: Weekly new favorites (start), combined with end value to form the upstream favorites_weekly range

fields.name: beginPrice
fields.description: Price (start), combined with end price to form the upstream price range (e.g., 20~100). When only one side is provided, the upstream returns start~ or ~end

fields.name: beginReviews
fields.description: Review count (start), combined with end value to form the upstream reviews range

fields.name: beginReviewsWeekly
fields.description: Weekly new reviews (start), combined with end value to form the upstream reviews_weekly range

fields.name: beginSales
fields.description: Total sales (start), combined with end value to form the upstream sales range

fields.name: beginSalesWeekly
fields.description: Weekly sales (start), combined with end value to form the upstream sales_weekly range (e.g., 1~100)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Product category ID (single category), see the Category Query API

fields.name: country
fields.description: Shipping country

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.description: Currency code

fields.name: endFavorites
fields.description: Favorite count (end)

fields.name: endFavoritesWeekly
fields.description: Weekly new favorites (end)

fields.name: endPrice
fields.description: Price (end), combined with start price to form the upstream price range

fields.name: endReviews
fields.description: Review count (end)

fields.name: endReviewsWeekly
fields.description: Weekly new reviews (end)

fields.name: endSales
fields.description: Total sales (end)

fields.name: endSalesWeekly
fields.description: Weekly sales (end)

fields.name: isBestsell
fields.description: Whether the product is a bestseller

fields.name: isPick
fields.description: Whether the product is a Pick item

fields.name: isRaving
fields.description: Whether the product is a Raving item

fields.name: listedTime
fields.description: Listing time no earlier than this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page number (starting from 1)

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Items per page, max 100, recommended not to exceed 50

fields.name: productType
fields.description: Product type, comma-separated for multiple: 1=Handmade 2=Vintage 3=Digital 4=Custom 9=Other

fields.name: searchKey
fields.description: Search keyword or Etsy product URL

fields.name: sortBy
fields.description: Sort field (corresponds to upstream sort_by, values 1~6)

fields.name: sortDesc
fields.description: Sort direction (corresponds to upstream desc). Schema example: descending 1, ascending 2 (encoding differs from store query's sortDesc)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Product status (example: 1=active, 0=inactive)
